# PARA Social Automation

> Public API contract for LinkedIn and Reddit discovery, external draft intake, human review, and approved extension publishing.

## Canonical sources

1. [Integration guide](https://para-linkedin-api.mintlify.app/agent.md)
2. [OpenAPI 3.1](https://para-linkedin-api.onrender.com/openapi.json)

Use the integration guide for lifecycle and safety rules. Use OpenAPI for exact
schemas, parameters, response codes, and examples. These two resources are the
complete integration contract.

## Complete flow

```text
GET /v1/me
  -> select project and platform registration
  -> GET /v1/{platform}/registrations/{registration_id}/posts
  -> POST /v1/{platform}/registrations/{registration_id}/drafts
  -> human review in dashboard
  -> dashboard confirmation
  -> durable publishing queue
  -> assigned extension publishes the approved snapshot
```

External draft submission is review intake. It does not approve, enqueue for
publishing, or perform a platform action. The public API exposes no approval or
publishing operation.

## Identity and resources

`User -> Workspace -> Project -> Platform registration -> Current posts/drafts`

- Call `GET /v1/me` first. It returns the API-key owner, safe credential
  metadata, projects, and LinkedIn and Reddit registrations.
- A project is the cross-platform business scope. A registration is one
  platform-specific discovery configuration inside a project.
- A public API key selects its owner and scopes, not a project.
- Use `GET /v1/projects` with `registrations:read` for paginated project state.
- New integrations should send an existing `project_id`. Omitting it keeps the
  legacy implicit compatibility-project behavior.
- Never invent IDs. Use returned project, registration, and post IDs exactly.

## Authentication

Send the owner API key only as `Authorization: Bearer $PARA_API_KEY` to `/v1/*`.
Never put credentials in URLs, bodies, logs, transcripts, or reports. Dashboard
sessions and paired extension device tokens are separate credentials and cannot
be derived from a public API key.

External draft creation requires `registrations:write`, `X-Request-ID`, and
`Idempotency-Key`. The same idempotency key and body returns the original draft;
the same key with a different body returns `409`.

## Registration modes

- `mode: discovery_only` equals `draft_enabled: false`: collect, match, enrich,
  batch, and deliver without PARA draft generation.
- `mode: draft` equals `draft_enabled: true`: preserve PARA generation.
- Supplying one field derives the other. Conflicting fields return `422`.
- Omitting both defaults to `draft`. External drafts work in either mode.

## Normalized current posts

Both platforms expose `GET /v1/{platform}/registrations/{id}/posts`:

```json
{
  "items": [{
    "post": {"id": "post-id", "url": "https://..."},
    "relevance": {
      "initial": {"status": "MATCH", "score": 0.68},
      "final": {"status": "MATCH", "score": 0.82}
    },
    "draft": {"id": null, "source": "generated", "comment": null},
    "score": 0.82,
    "status": "MATCH",
    "score_stage": "final"
  }],
  "next_cursor": null
}
```

`score` and `status` prefer final relevance when `final.score` exists and
otherwise use initial relevance. If neither score exists, `score` is `null` and
sorts after scored items. `score_stage` is `final` or `initial`. Results contain
only the current matching revision and use an opaque cursor. `/batches` remains
the immutable historical-delivery API.

## External drafts and review

POST to `/v1/linkedin/registrations/{id}/drafts` or
`/v1/reddit/registrations/{id}/drafts`:

```json
{"post_id":"post-id","comment_text":"Review-ready text"}
```

A successful `201` response is a `READY` review draft. A later external
submission for the same current matched post creates a new revision and marks
the prior external revision `SUPERSEDED`. PARA-generated draft provenance is
preserved. The newest active external draft is shown first in review.

A dashboard reviewer can edit the text and confirm it. Confirmation snapshots
the final text and source into the durable Postgres queue. Only the assigned
extension can later claim an eligible approved item. Queue cancellation does not
delete the draft. Only `POSTED` means the platform action completed.

## Webhooks

Verify `X-Webhook-Signature` as
`v1=hex(HMAC_SHA256(secret, UTF8(timestamp + ".") || raw_body_bytes))`. Reject a
timestamp more than 300 seconds from the receiver clock, compare in constant
time, and durably deduplicate `X-Webhook-Id`. Never verify re-serialized JSON.
